title: I Upgraded Pawns to BEAT Stockfish
summary: Tony's pawns become Goblins ('pawn on steroids') vs Fairy-Stockfish. A goblin moves and jumps up to two squares in any forward direction (straight or diagonal) and can leap over a piece (c2 over c3 to c4). They can't move backwards or defend sideways. He grabs the centre, wins material and mates with a goblin (~8:09).
rules: Goblin moves 1 or 2 squares in any of the three forward directions (straight forward, diagonal-forward left/right), and may jump over an intervening piece.
Goblin captures on those same squares (inferred from 'control over those squares' via overlapping move dots and capturing with goblins at 8:03).
Goblins cannot move backwards or sideways.
Promotion on the last rank (inferred: standard).
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish (won, with a goblin delivering mate).
